method: Real Home-to-result phone tasks, unchanged0.9 JEV gates. Hybrid admits exact caller-provided app, empty field/literal and swipe primitives directly, and uses JEV for navigation choices. A provided swipe is a test action through the general controller, not a saved product routine or a JEV decision. App launches use CoreDevice. Setup and cleanup are recorded separately. All task navigation, model choices, input, independent AX or specified screenshot/OCR checks and result captures are timed. Scroll checks compare text and positions in actual before/after frames. Capture stops on lock. All failures are retained; unknown input is never replayed. Match the same predicates and start states in Mirroring before comparing speed.
